verdict.stance: Overweight / Rising-Quality SEE Banking Champion Post-Nov-26 AT1 (A2 / BBB+ Pos)
verdict.summary: NLB Group (Slovenia & Western Balkans leader) achieved €503.1m FY25 PAT (29 bps CoR) and ~10%+ loan growth in 2026, prompting Moody's upgrade to A2 (Mar-26) and S&P Positive outlook on BBB+ (Jun-26). Its 17-Nov-26 €350m 7.40% AT1 issuance (XS3565258764) strengthens Total Capital & ALAC buffers for regional M&A and organic growth.

positives: Upgraded by Moody's to A2 (Mar-26) and placed on Positive outlook by S&P at BBB+ (Jun-26).
Consistent >€500m annual earnings power with low 29 bps FY25 cost of risk and ~2.1% NPLs.
Deep ALAC/MREL & AT1 buffers reinforced by €350m 7.40% AT1 (Nov-26) and €300m 6.50% AT1 (Nov-25).
negatives: 55% dividend payout ratio (€276.8m) plus bolt-on M&A appetite across SEE consumes organic CET1.
ECB rate cuts pressure floating-rate NII margins across Slovenia and Croatia/Serbia.
Higher coupon cost (7.40% vs 6.50%) on Nov-26 AT1 tranche.

background.business_overview: Slovenia's largest banking group with leading market shares across Serbia, North Macedonia, Bosnia, Montenegro, and Kosovo.
background.asset_perimeter: NLB d.d. (Slovenia), NLB Komercijalna banka (Serbia), NLB Banka Skopje/Sarajevo/Podgorica.
background.ownership_governance: Republic of Slovenia (25%+1), free float listed on LJSE (NLBR) & LSE GDRs (NLB).

recent_drivers: 2026 Upgrades: Moody's upgraded issuer rating to A2 (Mar-26); S&P revised BBB+ to Positive (Jun-26); Q226 PAT €133.1m.
